summary.en: Reusable 2D GPU spatial indexing with caller-controlled command submission.
summary.zh: 支持调用方控制命令提交的可复用二维 GPU 空间索引。

description.en: Allocate and prepare a two-dimensional count/sort neighbor-grid index.
description.zh: 分配并准备二维计数/排序邻域网格索引。

description.en: Grid dimensions and entity count; every field is specified below.
description.zh: 网格尺寸和实体数量，各字段见下方。

description.en: Ready grid with owned u32 index buffers. The input position buffer remains caller-owned.
description.zh: 已就绪的网格，拥有自己的 u32 索引缓冲；输入位置缓冲仍由调用者拥有。

errors.en: Throws plain Error for non-positive/non-integer count or cellSize not greater than zero. Allocation/context errors and CompileError can reject. worldHalf/workgroupSize and buffer/device-size feasibility are not fully validated.
errors.zh: count 非正整数或 cellSize 不大于 0 时抛出普通 Error。上下文/分配错误和 CompileError 也可能导致拒绝。不全面验证 worldHalf、workgroupSize 或缓冲/设备尺寸是否可行。

constraints.en: Factory already prepares the internal scan and pipelines. Explicit prepare() is idempotent and useful in generic composed workflows.
constraints.zh: 工厂已经准备内部 scan 和管线；显式 prepare() 幂等，可用于统一的组合工作流。

constraints.en: Positions outside the square are assigned to edge cells by clamping. This is not a toroidal/wrapping neighbor index. Cell order is sorted; order within a cell is not promised stable.
constraints.zh: 方形范围外的位置通过 clamp 归入边缘格子；这不是环绕世界的邻域索引。格子之间有序，但不保证格内实体顺序稳定。

constraints.en: Do not assume a 3×3 neighborhood covers your radius: ceil-based subdivision can make cells smaller than cellSize. Compute the search radius in cells from actual width.
constraints.zh: 不要直接假设 3×3 邻域覆盖交互半径：ceil 分格可能使实际格宽小于 cellSize，应根据实际格宽计算搜索格数。

caption.en: Build a grid in a caller-owned command encoder and read its index.
caption.zh: 在调用方的 command encoder 内建格，并读回索引。

exports.name: NeighborGridConfig
exports.signature: interface NeighborGridConfig { count: number; worldHalf: number; cellSize: number; workgroupSize?: number; }

description.en: Configuration accepted by createNeighborGrid.
description.zh: createNeighborGrid 的配置。

description.en: Positive integer entity count. The supplied position buffer must contain this many vec2f elements.
description.zh: 实体数量，必须为正整数。输入位置缓冲应含这么多个 vec2f 元素。

description.en: Half-width of the square world on each axis, nominally [-worldHalf, worldHalf]. Use a finite positive value; 2.0.0 does not validate it.
description.zh: 每轴方形世界的半宽，范围通常为 [-worldHalf, worldHalf]。应使用有限正数；2.0.0 不验证此值。

description.en: Requested cell size. gridSize=max(1, ceil(2*worldHalf/cellSize)), so actual cell width is 2*worldHalf/gridSize and can be smaller.
description.zh: 请求的格子尺寸。gridSize=max(1, ceil(2*worldHalf/cellSize))，因此实际格宽为 2*worldHalf/gridSize，可能比请求值小。

description.en: Declared configuration option but ignored by 2.0.0 implementation; shader and dispatch both use the fixed value 64.
description.zh: 声明中的配置项，但 2.0.0 实现未使用它；shader 和 dispatch 都固定使用 64。

description.en: Owned grid buffers and operations; destroy them when finished.
description.zh: 网格拥有的缓冲及操作；结束使用后销毁。

description.en: Number of cells on each axis: max(1, ceil(2*worldHalf/cellSize)).
description.zh: 每轴格子数：max(1, ceil(2*worldHalf/cellSize))。

description.en: Fixed at creation.
description.zh: 创建时固定。

description.en: Total cell count, gridSize × gridSize.
description.zh: 总格子数，即 gridSize × gridSize。

description.en: Length of cellStart and cellFill.
description.zh: cellStart 和 cellFill 的长度。

description.en: Owned u32 buffer of exclusive starting slots per cell.
description.zh: 各格子独占起始槽位，网格拥有的 u32 缓冲。

description.en: cells elements; use cellStart[c] as the inclusive start in order.
description.zh: 含 cells 个元素；cellStart[c] 是 order 中的包含式起点。

description.en: Owned u32 buffer of exclusive ending slots after scatter.
description.zh: scatter 后各格子的排他终止槽位，网格拥有的 u32 缓冲。

description.en: cells elements. Members of cell c occupy order[cellStart[c]..cellFill[c]); this value is not the occupancy count.
description.zh: 含 cells 个元素。格子 c 的成员位于 order[cellStart[c]..cellFill[c])；此值不是格内数量。

description.en: Owned u32 entity-index buffer, grouped by cell.
description.zh: 按格子分组的实体下标，网格拥有的 u32 缓冲。

description.en: count elements; order[slot] is the original entity index.
description.zh: 含 count 个元素；order[slot] 是原始实体下标。

description.en: Idempotently prepare the internal scan.
description.zh: 幂等地准备内部 scan。

description.en: Resolves when encoding dependencies are ready.
description.zh: 编码所需依赖就绪时完成。

description.en: Append counts → scan → post → scatter passes to the caller encoder.
description.zh: 向调用者 encoder 追加 counts → scan → post → scatter pass。

description.en: Unfinished encoder from the shared device. No active pass may lock it. The method does not submit or finish it.
description.zh: 来自共享设备、尚未完成的 encoder。不能被未结束的 pass 占用；方法不会自动 finish 或提交。

description.en: Caller-owned vec2f storage buffer with count positions on the same device. No dedicated kind/length validation is performed here.
description.zh: 调用者拥有、同一设备上的 vec2f storage 缓冲，含 count 个位置。此处没有专门的 kind/length 校验。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: One encode per grid instance per submission: submit, then call endSubmit(). Downstream passes in the same encoder can consume the resulting index without CPU readback.
constraints.zh: 每次提交前同一网格实例只能 encode 一次：提交后调用 endSubmit()。同一 encoder 的后续 pass 可直接消费索引，无需 CPU 读回。

constraints.en: The internal scan guard can throw after the initial counts pass has already been recorded on an invalid repeated call. Discard that encoder rather than submitting a partial failed build.
constraints.zh: 重复调用违规时，内部 scan 防护可能在 counts pass 已写入后才抛错。应丢弃该 encoder，避免提交失败的部分建格。

errors.en: Propagates scan UsageError for repeated encoding and WebGPU validation/device errors for incompatible resources or encoder state.
errors.zh: 重复编码时传播 scan 的 UsageError；资源或 encoder 状态不兼容时产生 WebGPU 校验/设备错误。

description.en: Reset the internal scan encode-once guard after an actual queue submission.
description.zh: 实际队列提交后重置内部 scan 的单次编码防护。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Does not submit or wait for completion. Calling early bypasses the intended lifecycle and can produce incorrect shared-buffer use.
constraints.zh: 不提交，也不等待完成。提前调用会绕过预期生命周期，可能错误复用共享缓冲。

description.en: Convenience build with an internal encoder and queue submission.
description.zh: 使用内部 encoder 和队列提交的便捷建格。

description.en: Same vec2f/count/device requirements as encode(pos).
description.zh: 与 encode(pos) 相同的 vec2f、count 和设备要求。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Automatically calls endSubmit after submitting. Returns before GPU execution completes; queue ordering or Buffer.read() synchronizes dependent work.
constraints.zh: 提交后自动调用 endSubmit。返回时 GPU 未必已完成；通过队列顺序或 Buffer.read() 同步依赖工作。

description.en: Destroy grid-owned index, count, uniform, and scan resources.
description.zh: 销毁网格拥有的索引、计数、uniform 和 scan 资源。

description.en: No return value.
description.zh: 无返回值。

constraints.en: Does not destroy the caller position buffer. Stop encoding/updating before disposal; do not use grid buffers after destruction.
constraints.zh: 不销毁调用者的位置缓冲。销毁前停止 encode/update；销毁后不要使用网格缓冲。
